MemeDef.label: embodied abundance
MemeDef.description:
A generous body is abundance made flesh. Leaders and moral guides are expected to embody it.

Qualifying larger adults known to a follower receive at least +5 body-size opinion. Other opinions can still make the total negative.
New adult social tastes are Likes or Strongly likes larger bodies. Existing tastes and personal size preferences stay fixed; extra feeding still requires willingness.
